name: Onyxia
source: [logs: Anniversary] Melee 1,309 to 2,166 before armor under the bench's raid debuffs, a swing every 1.92 s on the tank: Warcraft Logs, 21 kills on the Anniversary Hardcore realms (Normal, 2024-12-12 to 2025-03-02): the median of 237 normal hits' unmitigatedAmount (1,676), the 5th to 95th percentile of each hit over its own kill's median (237 hits) stretched to an even roll, and the swings a second while he was on the main tank. Taken back through the debuffs the bench puts on him (attack power 805 to 601, -37 a swing, attack speed 0.833): 1,083 weapon damage, spread 0.791, a 1.60 s swing. Length: the main tank's time on him a kill, median 35 s (10th to 90th percentile 26 to 49). Weapon damage abilities: Cleave 19983 1,603 to 2,548 from 58 hits; Knock Away 19633 1,284 to 2,427 from 22 hits. Abilities: Flame Breath 18435 3,063 to 3,937 Fire every 10 to 20 s, frontal on the tank. Cleave 19983 weapon damage + 50 every 2 to 5 s. Knock Away 19633 weapon damage + 30 every 15 to 30 s. Wing Buffet 18500 563 to 937 every 15 to 30 s. Values from the Classic Era client's spell data, timers from the vmangos script.

notes: Phase 1 and 3 on the ground only (the air phase at 65% to 40% is left out). Knock Away's 25% threat cut and Bellowing Roar's fear aren't modelled.

healing.notes: From the Anniversary Hardcore realms's logs (21 kills): while the boss was on the main tank, 8 healers had 5% or more of its healing (the median kill), and the healing it took from others was 1,391 a second with overheal and absorbs (31% of the heals effective), 1.79 heals and HoT ticks a second, against 469 damage taken a second. The tank's own heals (1% of its healing) are left out. Main tanks: Warrior 16, Druid 5.

raidHealing.notes: What the Anniversary Hardcore realms raids had on Onyxia (21 kills, Warcraft Logs): the median kill's raid of 40 with 3 tanks (0 of them on adds, who took 22 a second together, not in the events), 11 healers by Warcraft Logs' healer role (80% of the healing), each 182 HPS with overheal. The raid healed 1,335 a second (399 on the tanks, 895 on the rest, 36% overheal on the rest). Each non-tank took 22.6 a second after mitigation. Fight length is the 10th percentile, median and 90th percentile kill. For the healing sim to check its healer counts against.

raidSource: [logs: the Anniversary Hardcore realms] The raidDamage events with who NotTanks: Warcraft Logs, 21 kills (tools/warcraftlogs/wclcli.py raid, tools/encounters/logs/anniversary_onyxia_raid.json): the abilities that dealt 2% or more of the non-tanks' damage taken in 10% or more of the kills, 96% of it together, their rates scaled by 1.04 for the rest. Each is a share of the non-tanks, so the file fits any raid size. Fireball 18392 from Onyxia (32% of the non-tanks' damage, in 21 of 21 kills): 1,703 to 2,297 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 8% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 3 to 17), 7.3 landed a second on each (92% of it landing), so a cast every 8.18 s at random (the logs count 2.7 casts a minute), the first at 79 s (median) of a 137 s kill. Eruption 17731 from Lava Fissure (31% of the non-tanks' damage, in 21 of 21 kills): 1,325 to 1,685 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 3% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 3 to 10), 7.0 landed a second on each (100% of it landing), so a cast every 1.59 s at random (the logs count 6.6 casts a minute), the first at 102 s (median) of a 137 s kill. Flame Breath 18435 from Onyxia (14% of the non-tanks' damage, in 13 of 21 kills): 3,037 to 3,951 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 6% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 3 to 48), 3.3 landed a second on each (100% of it landing), so a cast every 13.1 s at random (the logs count 0.4 casts a minute), the first at 107 s (median) of a 137 s kill. Melee 1 from Onyxian Whelp (10% of the non-tanks' damage, in 21 of 21 kills): 305 to 482 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 3% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 3 to 14), 2.3 landed a second on each (63% of it landing), so a cast every 1.8 s at random (the logs count 3.7 casts a minute), the first at 57 s (median) of a 137 s kill. Cleave 19983 from Onyxia (4% of the non-tanks' damage, in 14 of 21 kills): 1,608 to 2,555 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 7% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 3 to 26), 1.0 landed a second on each (66% of it landing), so a cast every 19.67 s at random (the logs count 0.4 casts a minute), the first at 112 s (median) of a 137 s kill. Tail Sweep 15847 from Onyxia (4% of the non-tanks' damage, in 18 of 21 kills): 591 to 1,000 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 8% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 3 to 27), 0.9 landed a second on each (83% of it landing), so a cast every 39.99 s at random (the logs count 0.8 casts a minute), the first at 38 s (median) of a 137 s kill. Together they land 22.6 a second on each non-tank over a median kill, at the logs' mitigation, against 22.6 in the logs.
